description: This file defines a client class for interacting with AWS Migration Hub Orchestrator service in PHP. It extends the AwsClient class and declares various methods for managing templates, workflows, steps, and tags related to migration orchestration.

classes.name: MigrationHubOrchestratorClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Migration Hub Orchestrator, providing methods to interact with the service API.

methods.name: createWorkflowStep
methods.description: Creates a step within a migration workflow.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific migration template.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific migration workflow.
